replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics has always been my safe haven. I find comfort in its logical structure and predictability, unlike other subjects that feel chaotic to me. It's a subject where I can be confident and excel, providing a sense of stability in my life.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, no. Mathematics is one of the few areas where I don't feel overwhelmed or anxious. My high neuroticism makes me worry about many things, but math remains calm and predictable for me, offering a rare sense of security.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I have used AI tools recently. They were incredibly helpful in breaking down complex problems into manageable steps. The personalized feedback helped me understand concepts faster, and it felt like having a patient tutor available anytime.

Start by finding the first derivative dy/dx. Set this derivative equal to zero and solve for x values. Substitute these x values back into the original function to get corresponding y coordinates. These (x,y) pairs are your stationary points.
